signed_rows.behavior: A starter project bootstrapped for claude and antigravity passes apm audit --ci --no-drift --no-policy (exit 0) after install and kmctl plugin patch. OpenCode is out: APM's content-integrity check flags the agents kmctl plugin patch rewrites, and no audit flag skips it; the install how-to says so and the drift gate covers OpenCode.
signed_rows.fails_when: the audit exits nonzero for the claude and antigravity project
signed_rows.command: uv run pytest -m integration tests/test_starter.py -q -k audit_passes_for_claude_and_antigravity

signed_rows.behavior: The starter justfile has a recipe that runs a frozen install, kmctl plugin patch, and fails when git status --porcelain prints anything; on a fresh clone of the committed project it exits 0, and after a committed one-line edit to an installed skill it exits nonzero.
signed_rows.fails_when: the recipe is missing from the rendered justfile, exits nonzero on the clean clone, or exits 0 after the committed edit
signed_rows.command: uv run pytest tests/test_starter.py -q -k 'recipe or bootstrap' -m 'integration or not integration'

signed_rows.behavior: kmctl's MCP server is named bundle everywhere it is declared or checked, and no source, doc or test outside .loop/ and the okf-bundle rule names still uses okf-bundle for the server.
signed_rows.fails_when: apm/apm.yml or MCP_NAME is not bundle, or the package tests fail
signed_rows.command: uv run pytest tests/test_apm_package.py tests/test_plugin_patch.py tests/test_opencode.py -q

signed_rows.behavior: Doctor passes a bundle server that runs okf's script but not kmctl's launcher, and fails a bundle server that runs no okf script.
signed_rows.fails_when: either case gets the other outcome

signed_rows.behavior: The install how-to says CI runs apm audit --ci for a Claude Code-only install and apm audit --ci --no-drift plus the gate for Antigravity (and OpenCode if drift fires there), and ADRs 0014, 0018, 0019 and 0020 carry dated corrections or consequences for the rename and the drift; drop_old_mcp is gone.
signed_rows.fails_when: the docs give no working CI gate per harness, a correction is missing, or drop_old_mcp still exists

resigns.reason: r1 named OpenCode, which the plan left to be checked in the build: APM 0.33.0's content-integrity check fails on the three agents kmctl plugin patch rewrites and no audit flag skips it, so r1 covers claude and antigravity (issue #28's scope) and OpenCode goes to a follow-up ticket
